t: Look up and you'll see Father Time, the weathervane at Lord's Cricket Ground. He's a figure removing the bails from a wicket, and the whole vane stands about six and a half feet tall. The image comes from the Laws of Cricket, which say that after the call of Time, the bails are removed from both wickets. Sir Herbert Baker, the architect of the Grand Stand, gave it to Lord's in 1926. Broadcasters often call it Old Father Time, though Old isn't part of its official title.
